scheme_name: Union Territory of Lakshadweep Pension Scheme for Old Age
other_conditions: Applicant must be a permanent resident of the Union Territory of Lakshadweep
Applicant must not have any source of income
Applicant must not be a beneficiary of any other similar government pension scheme
Priority is given to applicants who do not receive financial support from family members
benefits_summary: Beneficiaries receive a monthly pension of ₹1,500 (₹18,000 per annum) deposited directly into their bank accounts.
